name: Roger Barahona
headline: Senior Product Owner | Product Manager | QSR & POS Technology | Enterprise SaaS
summary: Senior Product Owner with over a decade of experience leading digital transformation across global QSR and enterprise environments. Experience integrating POS, mobile ordering, delivery optimization and loyalty systems into unified SaaS platforms, defining product vision and scalable roadmaps, and aligning cross-functional teams across North America and LATAM.

Defined product roadmaps and translated stakeholder input into user stories, acceptance criteria and prioritized backlogs.

Led or supported Auto-Publishing and Screen Builder/Designer capabilities.
Led regional restaurant technology and POS deployment work across LATAM and the Caribbean.
Supported restaurant technology and POS initiatives across LATAM and the Caribbean.
Supported a real-time CFDI fiscal integration for Mexico restaurants for SAT compliance.
Led and supported POS deployments across Puerto Rico, Colombia, Curacao, Mexico, Cayman Islands, Aruba, US Virgin Islands and Trinidad & Tobago.
